pages.text: Crops $(bold)do not grow out of season$(). Hover seeds for their fertile seasons.$(br2)$(bold)Spring:$() carrots, potatoes, cabbage, onions, berries, most saplings$(br)$(bold)Summer:$() wheat, melons, tomatoes, onions, rice, sugar cane, cactus$(br)$(bold)Autumn:$() wheat, pumpkins, beetroot, carrots, cabbage, rice$(br)$(bold)Winter:$() sweet berries, spruce
Year-round: mushrooms, nether wart, cave vines.$(br2)Below $(bold)Y=48$() season is ignored: deep farms work all year. So does anything under a $(bold)glass roof$().

Any glass counts as greenhouse glass here: a crop with glass a few blocks above it grows as if in season. A glass roof over a lit, walled field is the winter plan. Build it in autumn and the pot stays full.
pages.title: Greenhouses

pages.text: $(bold)Rich soil$() (Farmer's Delight) speeds growth. Slice & Dice can automate the kitchen later; a sprinkler waters a field.$(br2)Trees ignore seasons. Berries, mushrooms and fish are the winter calories.
